narrative: Material PL3__M3487D49 exhibits continuous high-volume demand averaging 473.9 units/day with low coefficient of variation (CV=0.175), consistent with a gamma distribution. Lead times are short on average (1.01 days) but show moderate instability (CV=0.717) with occasional spikes to 3.7 days, requiring a meaningful safety buffer. The recommended (r,Q) policy with SS=685 and OQ=1,736 units achieves the 95% service target while reducing annual costs by ~69% through order consolidation. The storage capacity constraint is binding, capping the order quantity below the unconstrained EOQ of 2,320 units.
